verdict.rationale: Bento documents natural-language input for key configuration: failure-mode signals and alerts are written in plain English and compiled into detectors and trace queries. It also ships first-party Agent Skills that let coding agents carry out integration and migrations from a pasted prompt. However, general operation (triage, reading runs, analytics) is documented only through a structured CLI and dashboard, not natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language/chat interface for operating the product broadly (querying runs, triaging issues), any hands-on or independent corroboration.
